mutations.description: accept negative withdrawals (which increase the balance)
[independent QA R2-03a] debit guard off-by-one: withdrawing the exact balance rejected
[independent QA R2-03b] 1-cent overdraft tolerance in the debit guard

mutations.replace: _credit(db, sender_id, -amount)  # debit without the balance guard
mutations.description: [independent QA R2-03c] transfer path debits without the balance guard (sender can go negative)

mutations.find:
if not _debit(db, account_id, amount):  # REQ-03: never below zero, even under concurrency
        db.rollback()
mutations.replace:
if not _debit(db, account_id, amount):  # REQ-03: never below zero, even under concurrency
        _debit(db, account_id, account.balance)  # pay out what is available
        db.commit()
mutations.description: [independent QA R2-03d] rejected withdrawal still pays out what is available (balance changes on rejection)
always report the debit as successful regardless of whether the balance guard matched, allowing overdrafts to proceed
